name: Slider
summary: Single-value range control. One thumb sliding along a track. Distinct from RangeSlider (two thumbs / min+max). Used for volume, opacity, threshold sliders, audio scrubber. Thumb position rendered via inline style.left per AGENTS.md hard rule 12.

marks.description: Array of mark values to render on the track ([0, 25, 50, 75, 100]).

showValue.description: Render the value adjacent to the track.

rules: Per AGENTS.md hard rule 12 — thumb position rendered via inline style.left (not Tailwind arbitrary translate-x).
role='slider', aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext (when valueFormatter is used).
Min touch target on the thumb is 44 x 44 (use a transparent hit area larger than the visible thumb).

do: Position the thumb via inline style.left (per hard rule 12).
Pair with a value label when the precise value matters.
Use marks for common stop values.
Accent tone for default; neutral inside a colored container.
dont: Don't use Slider for ranges — that's RangeSlider.
Don't omit the value label on volume / threshold / opacity controls.
Don't render Slider on touch without expanding the thumb hit area to 44 px.

changelog.note: Initial Slider contract. Single-value variant. Inline-style thumb math (hard rule 12).
